notes.title: New Fantasy Game in Development — Join the Skeleton King: Isekai Harem Patreon!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p]
[p]I’m excited to announce the launch of my [b]official Patreon[/b] for [i]Skeleton King: Isekai Harem[/i] — a brand new fantasy game currently in development.[/p]
[p]This game invites you into the mysterious world of Magiterra, where the story unfolds in immersive chapters and you can be part of its creation.[/p]
[p]By joining the Patreon, you’ll get:[/p]
[list]
[*][p][b]Early access[/b] to new story chapters before anyone else;[/p]
[*][p][b]Exclusive behind-the-scenes[/b] content including concept art, scripts, and dev updates;[/p]
[*][p]Opportunities to [b]influence the story[/b] through polls and feedback;[/p]
[*][p][b]Exclusive side stories[/b] and unique extras you won’t find anywhere else.[/p]
[/list]
[p]Your support is crucial to help bring this amazing world to life and keep development moving.[/p]
[p]If you want to be part of this journey and help shape the future of Magiterra, join us on Patreon today![/p]
[p]👉 [url="https://www.patreon.com/skih"]https://www.patreon.com/skih[/url][/p]
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507981/dd932cf9f7a570443b604a7b181d2b862f89695f.png"][/img][/p]
[p]Thank you all for your support and enthusiasm. Let’s build this fantasy world together![/p]
[p]— Marlon[/p]

notes.title: Month Summary #03 +Update
notes.content:
[h1]It took a while but it arrived![/h1]

The first part of the latest game update has finally been released, now find out what's included in this version:

[list]
    [*]A new character has joined the team, a young lady with amnesia, some trauma and a lot, I repeat, a lot of anger at Sam.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5EzoP4g.png[/img]

As you can see in the image above, we will also have a new Boss and the possibility to use 4 team members in battles.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S7G3CAL.png[/img]

Both will introduce a new mechanic to the game, adding even more strategy to combats, which will be:
[list]
    [*]Evolution of weapons and equipment.
    [*]Character Transformation (If you watch anime, you probably know what I'm talking about, a stat boost, appearance change and new abilities while transformed).
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vh3zYl5.png[/img]

Furthermore, the time has come to start exploring the outside world, but for now, only a part of the [u][b]Frozen Continent[/b][/u].
Castles, villages, etc. Are still under development to bring more life into this new stage.

I wish I could tell you everything, but it would be too much [spoiler]spoiler![/spoiler]
In the next updates there will be some improvements in the battle system (ATB, as in the classic games of the Final Fantasy franchise).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/atB5IZz.png[/img]

I also need to mention that the ability to summon creatures has been removed and is being rethought, on the other hand, the game now has the option to change team members between the 4 battle slots in the [b]Formation[/b] Menu.

As new members join the team (we are currently 5) this will be an interesting mechanic to work on.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/66Cwapo.png[/img]

Other small improvements can also be noticed... So, as always, I ask for patience and [h1]enjoy the game![/h1]

notes.title: Month Summary #02
notes.content:
[h2][u][b]How are you?[/b][/u][/h2]
This month didn't have any major updates as I'm still working on it.
We will finally get out of Nephilim Village, I can also say that we will have new characters, story elements and meet the outside world ːcharmedː

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1xvDa7e.png[/img]

I appreciate everyone's patience so far, the last promotion exceeded all expectations, we doubled the number of players in a week and because of that I want to show you some old images of the game so you can get an idea of ​​what it was like.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fKZu3q1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iieO7iA.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fbA1TBb.jpg[/img]

The world used to be open too.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LP5q3zW.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/db65Mdw.png[/img]

It took two years from mobile to Steam, I take this opportunity to inform you that the Android version was discontinued due to some incompatibilities with graphics libraries, unfortunately at this moment I have to prioritize a version, so I chose Desktop.

And that's it, now I'm going back to work. Thank you again for each one of you who accompany the realization of this project and which is also a big dream in my life.
Hug. Marlon.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DPbBF9l.jpg[/img]
